decisions.statement: A caller hands the body in as a value rather than as a file.
A change stating no body takes its path away.
A body goes up through the change that works out the kind of path the change is handed.
A page's id is worked out by that change rather than by the landing.
Every page landed here arrives with an id.
A path outside the tracked trees is refused before anything is written.
Every change of a single call lands as a single commit or no change lands.
A change lands under no agent id and owes no reading.
A refusal is carried back to the caller rather than thrown.
The landing a change goes through is handed in.
A call that landed answers the paths landed and the commit holding them.
A landing that wrote before it went wrong says that same thing in its refusal.
A landing that threw after it committed is refused naming that commit.
Nothing here brings a body in off the tree.
Alan's tracking composes a whole body every time.
Nothing here knows a command line.
Nothing here reaches the disk for a body a caller already has.

definition: a body Alan's tracking composed, landed under the tracked trees or refused
